test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 29 Nov, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which figure should replace the question mark (?) if the following series were to be continued?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca13b1548ce8fd15b315bbaddfc4b80a20094acbe3f23af69fb27d0beac4f499.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

1) First box series →

The 1st and 2nd column elements shift clockwise subsequently.

The 3rd and 4th column elements shift anticlockwise subsequently.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a9d76dd221798def00eb0119ab139bb809d90c0f1282f3c137111f5aafa7aabe.png] 

2) Second box series →

The elements at the corners shift clockwise subsequently.

The rest of the elements shift clockwise subsequently.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/743559179155b9ca64c0a91d0d9d7a5a5cbfbab57530d740a9f9fa5eb60c2aa4.png] 

Thus, the final series is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c7606fcfa3d6fd37b7e3111a2b85648eeb818db30a4e1cabcd79cd04301788b3.png] 

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
